text:
I got a call from the field operator at Northline Gas Transmission Ltd. about an issue near
Thunder Bay, Ontario. They said on Aug 23 at 14:00, they found a natural gas release. The
gas released is sweet natural gas. The volume released was metered at 2.0 m³ and the
release rate was estimated at about 0.1 kg/s. The operator said it was due to frost heave, a
geotechnical failure. Everything stayed inside the station fence. No other details were given.
The field operator is still on site.
J. Smith, On-call Operator
